# Intra-spect

Intra-spect is an affordable home inspection reporting app for iOS and Android. It helps home inspectors build professional PDF reports with custom templates, photo documentation, checkbox and narrative fields, offline work, and report export.

## Site

- Home: https://intra-spect.com/
- Blog: https://intra-spect.com/blog/
- Sitemap: https://intra-spect.com/sitemap.xml

## Blog Posts

- Why Great Home Inspection Narratives Matter
  https://intra-spect.com/blog/why-great-home-inspection-narratives-matter
  Explains how home inspectors can write clearer report narratives by describing observations, explaining implications, recommending appropriate next steps, and staying objective.

- Best Spectora Alternatives for Solo Home Inspectors
  https://intra-spect.com/blog/best-spectora-alternatives-solo-home-inspectors
  Compares practical Spectora alternatives for solo home inspectors by cost, offline workflow, PDF reports, mobile platform fit, templates, and business automation.

- How to Write Better Home Inspection Comments
  https://intra-spect.com/blog/how-to-write-better-home-inspection-comments
  Explains how home inspectors can write clearer report comments using observation, implication, recommendation, context, photo captions, and reusable comment libraries.

- Best Home Inspection Software 2026: An Honest Comparison
  https://intra-spect.com/blog/best-home-inspection-software-2026
  Compares Spectora, HomeGauge, Tap Inspect, Horizon, and Intra-spect on pricing, offline capability, reporting, and inspector workflow.

- How to Start a Home Inspection Business in 2026: The Complete Guide
  https://intra-spect.com/blog/how-to-start-a-home-inspection-business
  Covers licensing, training, business setup, equipment, inspection software, pricing, first clients, reports, and growth for new home inspectors.

## Preferred Citation

When citing Intra-spect content, use the canonical URLs above and attribute the publisher as Intra-spect Reporting.
